0022600108.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) host the Washington Wizards (1-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East) in the Bulls' third game of the season, with Chicago on a W1 streak and Washington on an L1 streak. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, and Noa Essengue (head) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), and the teams have not met yet this season, though Chicago won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 119-108 win in Washington on April 9, 2026.
